# Verdent AI

> > Verdent AI: An AI-native workspace for parallel software development with multi-agent execution, Plan Mode, and autonomous coding workflows.

Verdent AI provides a conversation-driven development platform that enables focused, parallel software engineering through AI agents. The platform integrates leading LLMs including Claude, Gemini 3 Pro, and GitHub Copilot, offering workspace isolation, multi-agent execution, and customizable coding workflows for modern development teams.

- Verdent AI platform
